$comment: Every way an installed extension reaches the machine agent. The agent must keep supporting each protocol here that is not retired (agent test: installed_extension_protocols_stay_supported), the extension must use one of them (test/bridge-compat.test.ts), and a store release waits until a released agent supports its protocol. Never delete an entry: retire it, at least 60 days after its replacement was released. See README.md, Extension and agent compatibility.
